maddeler.e:
يشترعوا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِعُوا (yaštariʕū) /jaʃ.ta.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# يُشْتَرَعُوا (yuštaraʕū) /juʃ.ta.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
